At BairesDev, we’ve been delivering technology solutions for over 15 years with a diverse 4,000+ team working remotely on roles that drive impact worldwide.

title: Clinical Manager
description:
Join to apply for the Clinical Manager role at IQVIA .

IQVIA provides scientific services spanning clinical trials, real world evidence, and consulting in all areas of the product lifecycle. The Patient Centered Solutions (PCS) team leads the industry in generating data to ensure that the patient voice is incorporated into the development and commercialization of medication and other drug/non-drug interventions. We focus on understanding and meeting the needs of our clients – mostly life science/pharmaceutical companies – through the application of broad consulting expertise and technical scientific knowledge to design scientifically rigorous research. This research is broad and includes qualitative (e.g. interviews, focus groups), quantitative (e.g. clinical outcome assessments (COAs)/patient-reported outcomes (PROS), preference research) and passive (e.g. digital health technology tools) approaches to understand patient, caregiver and healthcare professional experiences and expectations of disease and treatment.

To meet our client expectations and retain the excellent reputation built up over time the IQVIA PCS team is committed to recruiting, training and supporting driven individuals who have both consulting skills and life science skills that can be applied to PCS research activities . Individuals joining us are assured of a rewarding and progressive career in patient-focused research. You’ll have the opportunity to address challenging client issues, across multiple geographies with a hands-on influence in developing and delivering solutions . We operate in a truly multi-cultural, collegial and collaborative work environment that is rich in development and growth.

Role & Responsibilities

The role-holder will need to be a committed individual, who combines high emotional intelligence and excellent communication skills. They will thrive in a fast-paced environment and be comfortable managing conflicting priorities. The environment is dynamic and ever-changing, moving at the pace of our clients’ needs and the candidate will be expected to understand the sense of urgency that is synonymous with the business.

As a Consultant, ClinRO Services within the PCS team at IQVIA, you will directly administer assessments to participants in a clinical trial, or evaluate the quality of assessments performed by others and provide feedback regarding interview technique and scoring . Responsibilities include:

  • Review of scales administered by raters in a clinical trial to ensure that assessments are being conducted in a standardized manner to ensure data reliability.

Embedded IoT / Edge Solutions Sales Representative, Manager and Director

Join to apply for the Embedded IoT / Edge Solutions Sales Representative, Manager and Director role at Canonical

Location: We are growing our sales reach in all regions - EMEA, APAC, and Americas.

Canonical is a leading provider of open-source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world\'s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring Embedded IoT / Edge Solutions Sales Representatives, Managers, and Directors to expand our reach in mission-critical industries such as Automotive, Medical Devices, Industrial Systems, Robotics, and Telco, as well as consumer electronics. We are looking for candidates who are technically skilled and familiar with embedded Linux and RTOS. We are expanding in all time zones, so we can accommodate candidates from almost any country as long as they have reasonable business access to a substantial market territory in person. As we grow our teams, we will also hire Sales Team Managers and Regional Sales Directors. Please continue with this process if your goal is a management leadership position.

The server edition of Ubuntu is already very widely used in connected devices and industrial PCs. Our newer edition of Ubuntu for IoT, called Ubuntu Core, represents the state of the art in security and resilience for high-end appliances and equipment. Our customers include global brands in consumer and industrial electronics, as well as automotive and robotics. We continue to expand our range of offerings to bring our security, management, and developer experience to the smallest Linux environments and devices. We recently added a real-time Linux capability and are working towards a range of certifications for these offerings. Together, this portfolio is Linux reinvented for optimal reliability, security, developer productivity, and footprint.

This is a prospecting sales and strategic account development role and requires energy, ambition, and focus. To be successful, you must be comfortable positioning and selling open source, services, and software solutions to all levels of an organization, and specifically to departments that are developing embedded software and IoT devices. You should also be familiar with at least one of our priority sectors.

Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute, and every category of application. Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting, and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote, and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.

We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position; it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision-making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long-term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world-leading company, we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment that promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration, and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.

In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers

Ubuntu is already widely adopted, which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. You will need judgment to determine which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. You will need professional practice, territory and account planning, and clear, complete, and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.

The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies, and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.

What we are looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Field sales experience in embedded Linux, embedded software, or enterprise software
  • Track record of achievement of sales targets and large account wins
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% for customer meetings and industry events
  • Ability to develop and execute territory sales plans
  • Detail oriented with effective follow-up

What we offer colleagues

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Communication Consultant - AICCRA Zambia
description:
Overview

The International Water Management Institute (IWMI) is an international non-profit, research-for-development organization working with governments, civil society, and private sector organizations to address water-related challenges in developing countries and scale up solutions. IWMI is headquartered in Colombo, Sri Lanka, and is a CGIAR research center with offices in 15 countries and a global network of researchers operating in approximately 56 countries. Accelerating Impacts of CGIAR Climate Research for Africa (AICCRA) supports the delivery of a climate-smart African future driven by science and innovation in agriculture. AICCRA works to make climate information services and climate-smart agriculture more accessible to millions of smallholder farmers across Africa. By improving access to technologies and advisory services—linked with information on effective response measures—farmers are better able to anticipate climate-related events, take preventative action, and protect their livelihoods while safeguarding the environment. AICCRA has teams in six countries: Senegal, Ghana, Mali, Ethiopia, Kenya, and Zambia. Its work is organized around four thematic areas: Priorities and Policies for Climate-Smart Agriculture; Climate-Smart Technologies and Practices; Gender and Social Inclusion; Climate Services. While country teams focus on accelerating impact within AICCRA’s six focus countries, several regional initiatives complement these national efforts, delivering benefits to a broader range of stakeholders across East, West, and Southern Africa. AICCRA is supported by a grant from the International Development Association (IDA) of the World Bank, which strengthens the research and capacity-building activities of CGIAR centers and initiatives, as well as their African partners. We are seeking a short-term (3 months) Communications Consultant to support the AICCRA Zambia team in developing and delivering communications products as part of the legacy communications campaign for the second phase of the project.

Responsibilities

  • Story Writing and Content Development: Coordinate with the Zambia team to draft and deliver 3–4 high-quality blogs, focused on specific Outcome Impact Case Reports (OICRs) from AICCRA Zambia’s portfolio.
  • Lead the development of a comprehensive and engaging ‘legacy story’ highlighting the team’s activities and overall impacts. This will include a thorough review of AICCRA Zambia OICRs (2021–2024), previously produced content, and relevant knowledge products.
  • Project manage the production of a short film in collaboration with a videographer and video editor, showcasing the impact of AICCRA’s work in Zambia.
  • Support deliverables and key activities during the consultancy with creative visual assets and social media copy, coordinating with AICCRA’s Global Communications Digital and Social Advisor to ensure effective promotion across digital platforms.
  • Document Management: Edit and proofread short- and medium-length documents for publication, ensuring clarity, accuracy, plain English writing, and compelling messaging.
  • Format documents in line with AICCRA templates and branding guidelines.
  • Upload publications and knowledge products to CG Space, the CGIAR knowledge repository.
  • Coordinate with editors and graphic designers on the preparation of larger publications and documents for release.
  • Team Coordination: Actively participate in team meetings and engage colleagues for input to strengthen communications outputs.
  • Provide regular updates to the cluster lead and Global Communications and Knowledge Manager.
  • Support additional related tasks and projects as assigned.

Deliverables

  • By the end of the 1st month - 2 x blogs and related social media content, outline for the legacy story, storyboard for the legacy film.
  • By the end of the 2nd month - 1 x blog and related social media content, first draft for the legacy story, first draft for the legacy film.
  • By the end of the 3rd month - 1 x blog, final draft for the legacy story, final draft for the legacy film and related social media content.

Minimum Educational Qualifications & Experience Required

  • Experience: 3–5 years in communications, digital marketing, or knowledge management.
  • Proven experience delivering communications products across different media formats for diverse audiences.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Required

Essential:

  • Consultant must be based in Zambia.
  • Familiarity with key issues in agriculture, food systems, climate change, or development in Africa.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills (native English standard).
  • Ability to design engaging content for social media platforms to a high standard using tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or equivalent.
  • Strong talent for interpreting complex subject matter and synthesizing it into accurate, engaging, and accessible content.

Desirable:

  • Supports peers with addressing complex issues.

Overview

About Us

Live Oak Bank is a digital bank that serves small business owners across the country. Our mission is to be America’s Small Business Bank, offering products that help customers buy, build, and expand their business, and high-yield savings and CD products to grow their money. We are committed to the well-being of our people and seek those who embody what it takes to empower the American dream.

How This Role Impacts Live Oak and its People

Responsible for ordering and reviewing loan due diligence documents while protecting the Bank’s interest from the time of approval through funding. Once approved by credit, the Senior Loan Closing Specialist quarterbacks the loan closing process by working closely with loan officers, underwriters, borrowers, attorneys, and the loan closing management team to ensure a smooth, error-free closing. Works with the Closing Team Manager to guarantee quality customer service and timely closings for customers and the Bank. Effectively manages a large pipeline while always treating each customer as the only customer.

What You’ll Do at Live Oak

  • Close for 5+ verticals at a minimum, including at least three product types (SBA, 504, Conventional, USDA).
  • Provide coaching and mentoring to Loan Closing Specialists I and II. Provide periodic updates to the Closing Training Manager on progression as needed.
  • Create, distribute, and maintain the loan closing checklist.
  • Collaborate with the borrower, attorneys, and third parties to ensure necessary documents are produced on time for the closing date.
  • Lead the closing kick-off call and be the point person for inquiries from borrowers and Bank personnel regarding loans in process.
  • Serve as the main point of contact with the borrower, answering questions to ensure understanding of the loan closing process with emphasis on customer service and closing details.
  • During the closing process, resolve or escalate potential problems to the Loan Team, Closing Team Manager, or Bank Attorney.
  • Assemble the credit file for accuracy and completeness prior to loan closing.
  • Maintain clean loan files and function in a Modified or Docs Only Pre-Funding Review process as needed.
  • Complete Pre-Funding Reviews for Loan Closing Specialists I and II as needed.
  • Ensure the loan closing date is met or, when necessary, reschedule and negotiate extensions of contracts if documents are not available or complete.
  • Order and review necessary documents including attorney-prepared closing and construction loan closing documents. Make independent decisions regarding validation of documentation to ensure underwriting and closing align with Bank and regulatory requirements.
  • Apply expertise and independent judgment to validate the loan structure with the lending team and work closely with the underwriter to address modifications properly.
  • Coordinate with Quality Assurance, borrowers, and attorneys to clear loan exceptions.

How You’ll Do It

  • Follow regulatory requirements including BSA, AML, CIP, and OFAC to help identify, detect, and deter money laundering or other unlawful activities.
  • Follow SBA SOP, USDA Operating Procedures, and Live Oak Bank requirements.
  • Function as a team member and recognize that all team members are vital to success.
  • Performs other duties as required.

Required and Preferred Experience

  • Five to ten years of experience with SBA and/or USDA preferred
  • Five to ten years of legal or lending experience preferred
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize workload.
  • Professional and confidential disposition; exercise judgment in handling confidential information.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Detail oriented with a high degree of accuracy.
  • High school diploma or GED required; college degree in business or finance preferred.

Our Values

  • Dedication: Possess a deep commitment to Live Oak Bank’s mission and core values, demonstrated through a strong work ethic, adaptability, and pride in your work.
  • Ownership: Take initiative to deliver positive results by proactively solving problems while maintaining quality.
  • Respect: Treat everyone with courtesy, politeness, and kindness.
  • Innovation: Embrace fresh ideas and contribute new solutions to problems.
  • Teamwork: Foster collaboration, accountability, and trust, understanding that together we do more.

WHO WE ARE

At Trustly, we’re on a mission to deliver a better way to pay and get paid. Consumers deserve a payment option that prioritizes financial responsibility, and merchants should have the independence to accept payments without unnecessary costs. This mission drives everything we do.

We’re revolutionizing the payments industry by making Pay by Bank the new standard at checkout, providing a smarter payment option to credit and debit cards. For merchants and consumers, this means the freedom to make and receive payments with greater security and ease.

Fueled by this purpose, we’ve grown into a global network connecting 9,000 merchants to 650 million consumers through 12,000 banks across 33 countries, processing over $58 billion annually. As the leader in Pay by Bank, we aim to redefine the payments experience by delivering exceptional products and unmatched value.

With regional offices in Vitória, Brazil and Silicon Valley, USA, and our global headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden, we are a diverse team that spans over 30 nationalities. Embracing a culture of innovation and collaboration, our 'work from anywhere' policy allows employees in Brazil, the U.S., and Canada to work remotely within their country of residence, enabling flexibility while staying connected to our global team.

At Trustly, we believe that inclusion and diversity are essential foundations for building a fair and equitable society. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, ancestry, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, or disability status. Our main goal is to provide a fair, welcoming, diverse environment with opportunities for all collaborators. The stages of our selection process take place online and without distinction of any kind.

Now is the perfect time to join us and help accomplish our mission. If you’re inspired by purpose, thrive in a fast-paced and entrepreneurial environment, and are ready to shape the future of payments, we’d love to hear from you!

About the team

The Merchant Operations team is responsible for clarifying, solving and escalating customer (merchant) and end-user queries or problems. We are responsible for supporting the internal, external, and third-party customers we use for processing.


What you will do:

  • The Role: As aClient Support Specialistat Trustly, you will be a brand ambassador and customer champion. You will report to the Manager, Customer Support, and leverage your experience supporting customers across multiple facets:
  • Omni-Channel: Supporting customers across channel types - email, chat/messaging, and phone (video in the future).
  • Trouble-shooting : Using a systematic approach to isolating, understanding, and solving complex problems.
  • Educate : Helping our customers maximize the benefits of using Trustly products & services.

  • Business/Financial : Answering questions related to financial and payment transactions which include payment status, payment declines, transaction inquiries, and collections inquiries and will change as the business evolves.

Who you are:

  • Empathy, passion, and obsession for helping customers.

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Software Maintenance Engineer to…
…work in a dynamic and exciting engineering role in Linux-based infrastructure and applications, covering all layers of the stack, including bare metal, virtualization (KVM), containerization (Docker/LXC/LXD), storage (Ceph and Linux filesystems), networking (OVS, OVN and Core networking), OpenStack, Kubernetes and the open source applications running on top of them. It will challenge you to show the breadth of your engineering skills, which will be needed to work on almost any aspect of Ubuntu and the open source applications large enterprise customers run.
This role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for Linux and open source to build a career with Canonical and drive success for our customers, community and the company. If you have an affinity for open source software, great communication skills, and a passion for troubleshooting and fixing issues in technology used by millions across the world, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
This role deals with critical issues in the open source stack that require upstream bug fixes. Our engineers are able to work productively at any level of the stack including the kernel and in a wide range of languages, to understand and address the software issues at hand. Our group is critical to the success of our customers, partners and Ubuntu itself.
You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.
Location: This is a remote role, we have teams in all time zones.
The role entails

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintain a close working relationship with Canonical's Field, Support and product engineering teams
  • Participate in upstream communities
  • Develop bug fixes, backport patches, and work with upstream for inclusion
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrate good judgment in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritize work and manage your time effectively against those priorities
  • Participate in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation
  • Maintain clear, technical and concise communications
  • Work from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Experience with Linux and open source software
  • Experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • A drive to learn unfamiliar technology and deep-dive difficult issues
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice-to-have skills
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have interest in, or willingness to learn about any of the following: Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD,Postgresql, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

title: Program Delivery and Business Development Manager - Dual-Use Robotics
description:
Overview


FLX Solutions is redefining how critical infrastructure is inspected and maintained using advanced robotic systems that enhance mission readiness and safety. Our patented FLX BOT solves one of the toughest challenges in maintenance: reaching the “last meter” in complex environments. It is a modular, collaborative, handheld articulating snake-like robotic platform, and is already in use in the U.S. Navy, Air Force, and shipbuilders with expanding applications in industrial, transit, and construction sectors.


The FLX BOT is 1" in diameter and can navigate confined or hazardous spaces on ships, bases, and aircraft. Its modular design includes interchangeable links with advanced cameras and sensors for obstacle avoidance, and its patented design offers greater articulation, lighter weight, and a smaller footprint than competing robots at a fraction of the cost. Operated by a single technician via handheld control or extension pole, it reduces labor and improves safety.


FLX Solutions has completed and launched pilots with the U.S. Air Force (D2P2 focused on aircraft wing fuel tank inspections at Robins AFB), U.S. Navy (corrosion assessment, 3D tank mapping), and a major DoD Prime. In paid Navy pilots, the FLX BOT reduced inspection times by up to 90% while eliminating the need for teardowns or confined space entry. FLX Solutions has 3 FLX BOTs deployed at the largest shipbuilder for the Navy, and a 1-year pilot with the NYC Metropolitan Transportation Authority (MTA).


The Opportunity: FLX Solutions is at a key inflection point: we have several high-value programs underway and are looking for a proven leader who can secure new contracts and successfully deliver them to completion. Your mission: capitalize on our momentum and scale our success. The FLX BOT technology is already proven and the market is responding. We have a high-confidence pipeline of over $18M including an upcoming large pilot order from the Navy. And this is just the beginning. We are looking for a proven operator to take ownership of critical programs and business development efforts. This is an experienced player role, not a management-only position (yet). While this role has a clear path to building and leading a team as we grow, your initial focus will be on rolling up your sleeves and personally driving. You\'ll work at the intersection of business development, program management, and operations, with the autonomy to take a customer relationship from initial contact to successful program delivery. You will partner directly with the CEO on capture strategy and customer engagement, and with our technical teams to ensure what we sell is what we deliver. The role also involves jumping into whatever business operations tasks are needed to grow the company and complete projects ranging from negotiating a defense contract to refining internal processes, or jumping on a late-night call with a customer in the middle of a trial. We need someone who has been on the startup journey before and helped grow a hardware company from seed stage through commercialization and scale, and has experienced the problems we’re solving first-hand.



What You’ll Do



Business Development and Program Acquisition



  • Identify, pursue, and close new contracts in defense and commercial markets, with an initial focus on high-potential opportunities already in the pipeline

  • Work directly with the CEO on capture strategy, proposal development, and customer engagement

  • Build trusted relationships with decision-makers at government agencies, prime contractors, and industrial partners

  • Lead the proposal and capture process end-to-end: lead the preparation of proposals, RFP responses, and competitive bids from end-to-end: shaping requirements, identifying teaming opportunities, selecting acquisition pathways (BAAs, CSOs, IDIQs, etc.), and submitting winning proposals



Program Leadership and Delivery



  • Serve as the Program Lead for our defense accounts, starting with the execution and multi-site deployment for the U.S. Navy and Air Force programs

  • Act as the primary customer interface for dual-use programs, managing scope, schedule, and budget to ensure all commitments are met

  • Partner with our hardware and software teams to manage technical requirements, identify risks, and guarantee what we sell is what we deliver



Operational Leadership



  • Establish and refine program management processes that can scale with the company

  • Track KPIs for program health, customer satisfaction, and revenue performance

  • Take on diverse business operations tasks that support company growth and program success as an early member of a growing team



Strategic Contribution



  • Work with leadership on market opportunities, partnerships, and program prioritization

  • Represent FLX at customer sites, program reviews, trade shows, conferences, and industry networking events

  • Identify new growth opportunities for business and technology expansion



You Are



  • Experienced in both winning and managing complex programs in defense, aerospace, robotics, and/or other dual-use technology sectors

  • Skilled at working at the intersection of business development, program management, and operations

  • Deeply familiar with DoD procurement processes and effective at building strong customer relationships with government agencies, primes, and dual-use customers

  • Comfortable in a startup environment, able to switch between high-level strategy and hands-on execution

  • Highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple high-value projects at the same time

  • Understanding of the business constraints in early stage companies and able to work within them

  • A startup veteran experienced in helping grow startups from seed stage to full commercialization and scaling operations



Qualifications


Required



  • 5-8+ years in program management, business development, or operations in relevant industries

  • Startup or scaling-company experience in hardware or robotics

  • Proven ability to secure and deliver multi-million-dollar programs including DoD acquisition and contracting

  • Established network in Navy, Air Force, shipbuilding, or major industrial maintenance programs

  • U.S. citizenship (due to DoD requirements)

  • Willingness to travel for customer meetings, pilots, and events

  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills

  • Experience and proficiency with modern tools including AI tools, CRMs, and Project Management tools (e.g. ClickUp)



Preferred



  • Firsthand DoD operational experience, particularly as a Veteran of the U.S. Navy or U.S. Air Force (e.g., Engineering Duty Officer)

  • Have led/been involved in the successful fundraising of capital at an early stage dual-use startup

  • Technical background

  • PMP certification or equivalent project management experience



Company Core Values



  • Do what you say, say what you do

  • We all make mistakes; it is what we do afterwards that defines us

  • Treat all with respect. Period.

  • Leave a situation better than you found it

  • Just because something has always been done a certain way, doesn’t mean it has to be done that way in the future



Compensation and Location



  • Salary: Competitive for an early-stage company, with significant performance-based increases tied directly to the programs you deliver and expand

  • Equity: A meaningful, early-stage equity grant. You will be a critical part of our success, and your compensation will reflect that.

  • Location: Remote-friendly. However, we have a strong preference for candidates in a key defense or technology hub (DC area, San Diego, Norfolk, Seattle, Bay Area, NYC) or near our Bethlehem, PA HQ, to enhance collaboration with our team and customers.

  • Flexibility: Will adapt role and package for the right candidate

title: IoT Solutions Architecture Manager
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

We are hiring an IoT Solutions Architecture Manager to lead a regionally-focused team of Field engineers in Presales and Professional Services activities, by helping customers with solution architecture, design and delivery.

Location: This is a remote role, running a team in one of three Geos, Americas, EMEA or APAC. You will therefore need to be located in one of those three Geos to manage that specific team that spans few timezones from you.

Our Internet of Things mission is to enable companies to make fleets of very secure connected devices. Canonical provides the base Ubuntu OS and kernel, with secure update and management mechanisms. Our customers create mission-critical control systems, gateways and appliances that need to meet stringent quality and security requirements, and we aspire to bring this level of security to the wider consumer electronics and device market.

Our Field Engineers are thought leaders helping our customers solve hard problems. They are accomplished technologists that take a hands-on approach to embedded Linux strategy and delivery. They have a passion to help customers achieve ambitious technical and business goals, and to show how the Canonical approach to open source and connected devices brings best-of-breed thinking to the emerging field of edge compute. They also care to develop their colleagues, helping them deepen their understanding of the technology, their ability to manage time, and their awareness of customer business thinking for continuous improvement and personal development.

This career opportunity requires a unique blend of skills. Successful candidates will know Linux well and be proficient coders and scripters. They will have experience of low-level Linux boot, BIOS, firmware and embedded software development methodologies. They also enjoy the pace of change and diversity of client engagements with driven and ambitious technology entrepreneurs. Competitive, business-focused technologists at heart, they are also team drivers that take pride in team and company wins.

Role responsibilities

  • Lead and develop a team of Field engineers, ranging from graduate to senior, in the areas of Presales and Professional Services
  • Solve customer problems by promoting our technologies and being a trusted advisor
  • Work remotely in a single major time zone
  • Coach, mentor, and offer career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and product to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and evangelise great engineering and organisational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on agreed goals and projects
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders

What we are looking for

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science or related technical field
  • Extensive embedded Linux experience - Yocto or other
  • Extensive Linux experience - Debian or Ubuntu preferred
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, Python, C, C++, or Rust
  • Ability to manage a small team
  • Experience with customer engagements
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • An ability to communicate the business benefits of technology
  • An humble learner and quick study

Other desirable traits include RTOS experience, additional languages (both the programming and human kinds), and previous experience working in a remote-first, diverse, distributed company.

What we offer you

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Consultant, Global Pricing & Access (Remote)
description:
At EVERSANA, we are proud to be certified as a Great Place to Work across the globe. We’re fueled by our vision to create a healthier world. How? Our global team of more than 7,000 employees is committed to creating and delivering next-generation commercialization services to the life sciences industry. We are grounded in our cultural beliefs and serve more than 650 clients ranging from innovative biotech start-ups to established pharmaceutical companies. Our products, services and solutions help bring innovative therapies to market and support the patients who depend on them. Our jobs, skills and talents are unique, but together we make an impact every day. Join us!

Across our growing organization, we embrace diversity in backgrounds and experiences. Improving patient lives around the world is a priority, and we need people from all backgrounds and swaths of life to help build the future of the healthcare and the life sciences industry. We believe our people make all the difference in cultivating an inclusive culture that embraces our cultural beliefs. We are deliberate and self-reflective about the kind of team and culture we are building. We look for team members that are not only strong in their own aptitudes but also who care deeply about EVERSANA, our people, clients and most importantly, the patients we serve. We are EVERSANA.

THE TEAM

Our Global Pricing & Market Access (PMA) team at Navlin is a dynamic, international group that combines deep inhouse expertise with real-time intelligence—from pricing and HTA updates to regulatory news—via Navlin’s industry-benchmark platform. Empowered by advanced price-management software and launch-sequence simulation tools (navlin.com), we deliver strategic, well-informed recommendations on pricing and access for our clients.

Composed of top talent from across Europe, our multicultural team blends local market nuance with creative synergy. We embrace a flexible remote-working model—fully supported by robust IT tools—and maintain satellite offices in London, Berlin, and Milan, freely accessible to all team members. Our team is rapidly expanding with consistent year-on-year growth.

Our project portfolio includes critical initiatives such as, among others, launch sequencing and pricing strategies for ATMPs and orphan drugs, indication-expansion planning, LOE strategy, forecasting, and asset due diligence—spanning Europe and global markets. While a dedicated team oversees U.S. initiatives, we lead global efforts across Europe, APAC, and LATAM.

We also collaborate closely with EVERSANA’s internal functions—commercial, HEOR, medical affairs, and others— in global launch execution projects, ensuring PMA remains central to global launch execution of new assets

THE POSITION

The Consultant, Global Pricing and Market Access position will be involved in delivering client consultancy projects and helping to manage project-related analytics, data and tools available through our industry platform Navlin or dedicated secondary and primary research. The Consultant will ensure that tasks within client projects or internal activities are delivered to schedule, while maintaining the highest level of quality and value expectations.

The Consultant will lead research and analysis focused around: pricing, market access launch strategy, competitor research, value-based pricing analyses, HTA, etc. The Consultant will be involved in identifying client needs and problems and implementing robust strategic and data driven solutions, while managing own workload to prepare the client deliverables. In addition, the Consultant will also contribute to business development through the development of proposals. Activities will be executed under the guidance of an Engagement Manager, mainly remotely due to remote team composition. In some cities with physical EVERSANA offices, the Consultant is fully able to use the company office, as well.

The role is home office based, (full-time position), located in Italy, Remote.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Our consultants are tasked with delivering excellent business results through the efforts of the project team. These results are achieved by:

  • Designing and executing client analyses & deliverables
  • Developing client reports and presentations and delivery of all or significant portions of findings to client
  • Providing follow-up with client after project deliverable has been completed to ensure client satisfaction
  • Leveraging business experience and acumen in identifying strategic alternatives and project approach to client questions, applying a solution-orientated approach and looking to add client value wherever possible
  • Developing of intellectual property for use on future engagements
  • Developing broader and deeper knowledge of consulting methodologies and life science know-how through on-the-job experience and training
  • Applying high attention to quality and detail with strong written and spoken English
  • Applying excellent PowerPoint and Excel skills, and ability to present information in compelling and creative ways (story telling through data, insights, effective slides)
  • Occasional management of more junior resources, such as associate consultants or interns
  • Working effectively in a remote environment, often with limited face-to-face contact with team members and client counterparts
  • However, working under supervision of a more senior member of the team, usually with daily alignments on operative tasks.

MINIMUM KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES

The requirements listed below are representative of the experience, education, knowledge, skill and/or abilities required.

  • B.S./B.A in relevant field of study required (life sciences or economic/managerial sciences, medical engineering).
  • 2-4 years of pharmaceutical, medical/health industry-related experience and/or 2-4 years management consulting experience
  • Understanding of life sciences business practices and the issues clients face in specific segments of responsibility
  • Strong conceptual, analytic and problem-solving skills
  • Strong knowledge of the market research development process
  • Strong quantitative and qualitative market research skills.
  • Proficiency in MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook
  • Ability to structure and use large amounts of data and other types of information from multiple sources to complete a final analysis of a business question/situations and make recommendations
  • Ability to work under pressure, meet deadlines, and work on several projects and multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Demonstrated self-awareness and accountability
  • Ability to lead and own personal projects
  • Ability to establish credibility in front of clients at companies
  • Willingness and ability to travel approximately up to 10% of annual worktime, mainly for off-site company events

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Advanced degree (e.g., MBA, MS, MPH).
  • Background in International Pricing and Market Access, analytics and modelling/forecasting would be a plus to effectively lead Global Pricing and Market Access projects for key clients.
  • 2+ years of management consulting experience.

Atuamos em 11 localidades pela América Latina, com o propósito de desmaterializar o universo financeiro para impulsionar a sociedade.

Como é o nosso time de CSM (Customer Success Management)

Como guardiões da jornada dos nossos clientes, o time de CSM da Dock atua de forma estratégica, consultiva e orientada a dados. Com profundo domínio sobre nossas soluções e serviços, utilizamos nossa expertise para identificar desafios e transformá-los em oportunidades. Nossa missão é promover o sucesso dos clientes, elevando sua performance operacional através de experiências que transformam resultados em conquistas. Construímos relacionamentos estratégicos com nossos clientes, conduzindo interações em canais como Slack e WhatsApp, além de reuniões de governança com apresentação de Books de Indicadores, garantindo alinhamento e confiança em toda a jornada. Gerenciamos a operação ponta a ponta, monitorando indicadores e SLAs do Help Center (Jira), identificando oportunidades para reduzir a recorrência de tickets por meio do autosserviço e da adoção de boas práticas no uso das nossas soluções. Atuamos de forma proativa e consultiva, explorando diferentes caminhos para cada solução e apresentando ideias que geram valor real aos clientes. Conhecemos nossos clientes tão bem quanto eles mesmos, mergulhando em suas operações para compreender necessidades e objetivos com precisão, o que nos permite conectar com diferentes áreas da Dock para garantir que nossas soluções sejam utilizadas em toda a sua essência.

No dia a dia, você irá:

  • Atuar em um ambiente dinâmico, apoiando clientes em demandas que envolvem tecnologia, estratégia comercial e performance operacional, aplicando conhecimento em APIs para resolver necessidades com agilidade e eficiência;

  • Ser o guardião do cliente inclusive em cenários de crise (War Rooms), mantendo comunicação proativa com perfis técnicos e não técnicos para garantir alinhamento e resolução ágil de incidentes;
  • Conduzir atendimento consultivo e estratégico, por meio de Slack, WhatsApp, e-mail, ligações e reuniões, garantindo interações de valor com stakeholders de diferentes senioridades (Analista a C-Level);

Também é legal você saber que...
Um dos nossos 7 valores é o “Sawabona", seu significado é pra lá de especial, e praticado diariamente aqui na Zappts!
A saudação #Sawabona se originou no Sul da África, onde se acredita que todos nascemos pessoas boas, mas que, às vezes, podemos cometer alguns erros.
Segundo a cultura deste lugar, quando alguém comete erros, toda a população se junta e, durante dois dias, só falam sobre as coisas boas que aquela pessoa já fez. Ao final desse período, todo o povo cumprimenta seu conterrâneo com a expressão "Sawabona".
Esse, por sua vez, responde "#Shikoba" . Sendo assim, Sawabona significa: "Eu te vejo, eu te respeito, você é importante para mim" . E a resposta, Shikoba: "Então eu sou bom e existo para você" .
Aqui na Zappts, Sawabona traduz e representa o que mais prezamos em nossas relações: o respeito e a valorização do outro.
Se você é apaixonado por tecnologia e sentiu conexão com os nossos valores, venha para nossa tribo aqui é seu lugar!

title: Analista de Pricing I
description:
Visão geral

O isaac é a maior plataforma de soluções financeiras feita para escolas. Impulsionamos as instituições oferecendo receita garantida e proporcionando mais flexibilidade de pagamento para as famílias.

Nosso objetivo é facilitar a gestão financeira, acabando com a dor de cabeça e permitindo que a escola consiga focar na missão de educar , dedicando mais tempo e recursos para tirar os planos do papel.

Nos últimos 4 anos, já ajudamos mais de 2.000 escolas , garantimos mais de R$5bi em mensalidades garantidas, e ajudamos a aumentar em 9% o número de matrículas em nossas escolas parceiras.

A cultura do isaac incentiva a autonomia, a mão na massa, o trabalho em equipe e o uso de dados para construir soluções inovadoras.

Temos muito para construir e transformar na Educação brasileira, e você pode fazer parte dessa revolução, vivenciando o impacto do seu trabalho na sociedade!

Vem com a gente?

Sobre a área:

A área de pricing ops fica na vertical de rentabilidade, área responsável por garantir toda a jornada de rentabilização das escolas. Em pricing, somos responsáveis por realizar a precificação das escolas no primeiro contato com o isaac, ou seja, somos responsáveis por receber os relatórios financeiros das escolas e traduzir em dados para o input no modelo de precificação, resultando no preço para a escola. É uma área que pode ser uma ótima porta de entrada para áreas mais analíticas e de negócios.

Responsabilidades

  • Investigar relatórios financeiros em diferentes formatos (de dados de ERP a fotos de cadernos), traduzindo-os em dados precisos e confiáveis para o nosso modelo de precificação.
  • Atender o SLA de precificação, onde nossa principal área cliente é o time comercial;
  • Ser proativo em propor melhorias para o processo;
  • Lidar com uma área multidisciplinar, onde temos interação com times comerciais, de ciência de dados, estratégia e sucesso do cliente;
  • Ter atenção plena durante as análises para identificar oportunidades, e apoiar as escolas e consultores na geração correta de relatórios quando necessário; exercendo seu senso crítico para tomada de decisões.
  • Adaptar-se com agilidade e atitude positiva às mudanças de estratégia e cenário, entendendo que a evolução faz parte do nosso crescimento.

Habilidades necessárias:

  • Boa habilidade de comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Vontade de aprender e curiosidade para explorar melhorias no processo;
  • Senso de urgência e responsabilidade;
  • Gestão de Tempo;
  • Forte viés de resolução de problemas e pensamento crítico;
  • Excel avançado
  • Conhecimento em SQL;
  • Auxílio alimentação e/ou refeição (Flash benefícios - R$40,50/dia);
  • Auxílio home office no primeiro mês de trabalho (R$200,00);
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico Sulamérica sem mensalidade e com coparticipação;
  • Licença maternidade (180 dias) e paternidade (30 dias) estendida;
  • Auxílio creche para mamães e papais com filhos até 06 anos;
  • Cuidado com a saúde física para você e seus dependentes: parceria com a Wellhub (Gympass);
  • Incentivo à educação - parcerias com diversas instituições de ensino;
  • ArcoLab - plataforma de educação corporativa;
  • Desconto em passagens aéreas e hospedagens;
  • Férias flexíveis (antecipação de 15 dias de férias após 6 meses).

#MaisDiversidade

Acreditamos que em um ambiente diverso e inclusivo nossas pessoas serão mais felizes, engajadas e com mais chances de atingir o seu máximo potencial . Por isso, aqui no isaac - uma empresa do Grupo Arco Educação, respeitamos e valorizamos a igualdade de direito, reconhecemos as singularidades e acreditamos que todas as pessoas podem contribuir para o nosso propósito. #vempraisaac

title: Direct Response Copywriter
description:
Overview

Job description

Pure is looking for a Direct Response Copywriter to join our team! As our creative head, you will be responsible for the ideation, scripting, planning, and managing of the entire creative process with a big focus on UGC ads and psychology-based creatives to be used across paid marketing channels.

We are looking to hire someone with 3+ years of work experience. The ideal candidate has prior experience in creating paid advertisements specifically for Meta Platforms, UGC, direct response marketing & bonus points if experience with influencer / UGC partnerships.

Who are we?

At Pure, we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. Our mission is to make achieving better health simpler, more effective, and more accessible for everyone. Since our launch, we’ve scaled rapidly through viral digital marketing and built a passionate customer base that loves and trusts our products. We operate with a small but mighty team that thrives on innovation, data-driven growth, and relentless creativity—and we’re excited to bring on a Creative Strategist to play a pivotal role in scaling our brand even further.

What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values : "work smart", "overdeliver", "speed is king" and "better everyday". We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders- and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Qualifications

  • Requirements :
  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise : 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics : Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience : Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset : Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn’t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.
  • Write 80-100 high-converting ad scripts per week for Meta Platforms
  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.
  • Collaborate with editors and designers to ensure ads are visually compelling and on-brand.
  • Adapt ad strategies to capitalize on emerging internet trends and consumer behaviors.
  • Present performance analyses and creative strategies to the marketing team
  • Continuously refine ad concepts and troubleshoot underperforming campaigns to achieve maximum ROI.
  • Iterate on winning ads to create more winning assets to produce a better ROI.

How Our Hiring Works & How We Operate

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.

Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project with the current head of marketing, and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.

For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!

Salary Expectation

USD $36,000 USD to $70,000 USD per year + Performance Bonus Structure based on experience and expertise.

Join to apply for the Strategic Account Executive role at Canonical

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.
We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.
Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.
Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.
We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.
In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes

Join to apply for the Software Maintenance Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Software Maintenance Engineer to…
…work in a dynamic and exciting engineering role in Linux-based infrastructure and applications, covering all layers of the stack, including bare metal, virtualization (KVM), containerization (Docker/LXC/LXD), storage (Ceph and Linux filesystems), networking (OVS, OVN and Core networking), OpenStack, Kubernetes and the open source applications running on top of them. It will challenge you to show the breadth of your engineering skills, which will be needed to work on almost any aspect of Ubuntu and the open source applications large enterprise customers run.
This role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for Linux and open source to build a career with Canonical and drive success for our customers, community and the company. If you have an affinity for open source software, great communication skills, and a passion for troubleshooting and fixing issues in technology used by millions across the world, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
This role deals with critical issues in the open source stack that require upstream bug fixes. Our engineers are able to work productively at any level of the stack including the kernel and in a wide range of languages, to understand and address the software issues at hand. Our group is critical to the success of our customers, partners and Ubuntu itself.
You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.
Location: This is a remote role, we have teams in all time zones.
The role entails

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintain a close working relationship with Canonical's Field, Support and product engineering teams
  • Participate in upstream communities
  • Develop bug fixes, backport patches, and work with upstream for inclusion
  • Review code produced by other engineers

  • Work from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Experience with Linux and open source software
  • Experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • A drive to learn unfamiliar technology and deep-dive difficult issues
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice-to-have skills
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have interest in, or willingness to learn about any of the following: Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD,Postgresql, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. Overview

At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people\'s lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our employees are not only part of history, they\'re making history.

The Payload and Ground Systems Division within Northrop Grumman Space Systems is a strategic partner specializing in delivering intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance solutions for classified and unclassified missions in space. Headquartered in Linthicum, Maryland, PGS RSP has offices, manufacturing, and world-class assembly, integration, and test facilities. We do it all here, on-site, from sensors to payloads to full up spacecraft, supporting Class A to Class D missions. Our key capabilities include Active RF, Passive RF, and Electro-Optical payloads, space solar power, cross domain missions, and space resilience payloads & solutions.

This position is for a Staff Systems Engineer to join our Remote Sensing Programs Systems Engineering, Integration and Test (RSP SEIT) team as a SEIT Lead . As a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to support efforts on both concept and product development to deliver key solutions to our customers. We cover a wide variety of expertise within the systems engineering domain. This includes mission engineering, requirements, architecture, modeling and simulation, integration and test, verification, and validation, and many more!

The SEIT Lead is responsible for directing the execution of the overall systems engineering, integration, and test (SEIT) effort on the program and is responsible for horizontal and vertical integration across all engineering elements of the program. The ideal candidate ensures the integrity of engineering processes and timely development of core engineering work products. The SEIT Lead typically has Control Account Manager (CAM) responsibility, which comprises cost and schedule management for the SEIT work scope. And interfaces with the Program Manager, Chief Engineer, System Architect, other engineering team leads, as well as the customer.

The position will be responsible for leading systems engineering tasks for space subsystems, payloads and/or vehicles. These may include, but are not limited to:

  • Serve as the cost account manager for the systems engineering (and potentially multiple other organizations) responsibilities.
  • Plan and execute the core functions and ensure the project team has qualified staff to execute the program core functions.
  • Lead technical management and execution of the SE team.

Who are we?

At Pure, we are dedicated to transforming lives by creating high-quality supplements backed by science and trusted by our growing community. What is our culture like & who is a good fit?

Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We utilize creativity to do more with less - and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by the following three core values: work smart, overdeliver, speed is king and better everyday. We love learning - every problem is an opportunity to grow. If you want a stress-free corporate 9-5 job, this isn't it.

If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founders - and play a huge role in scaling it to $12M+ a year. Drive results with a group of passionate, smart & hardworking fun people. Work in an environment without politics, or corporate chicanery. Play a big part in our growth being hands on, active, and doing what is necessary with an excellent bonus plan based on performance then you have come to the right place.

Key Objectives

  • Manage the full creative process (from scripting all the way to final creative) in order to produce high converting creatives on an ongoing basis.
  • Work with our content manager to find, manage and source new content to be used across all marketing channels
  • Drive measurable improvements in core advertising metrics across digital channels with improved creatives.
  • Script UGC Direct response creatives
  • Use data from creative performance on Meta to dissect, analyze and improve upon our creatives to continuously improve performance across our creatives.
  • Work with our marketing team to come up with new creative concepts and ideas.
  • Conduct strategic customer and competitor research to better optimize creative efforts
  • Provide creative reports on a monthly and quarterly basis
  • Decide on the next steps needed to scale Meta Ads further through better creative

Requirements

  • Fully remote
  • Fluent in English
  • Direct Response Expertise : 3+ Years Experience with performance creative for DTC brands or working at a creative agency is a must.
  • Tools & Metrics : Proficiency in performance analytics tools such as Triple Whale, Motion, pitch decks, and spreadsheets to present ideas and campaign outcomes effectively.
  • UGC Experience : Lots of experience with creating briefs for UGC creators to produce high converting content across paid channels.
  • Creative & Analytical Mindset : Ability to generate fresh ideas, write scripts, shot listing, and make data-driven decisions based on ad performance.
  • No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You wouldn’t know what to do with your free time if you were working less. You are passionate about your work.
  • Excellent cultural fit as per our values above.
  • Are excited to play a big role in scaling the company and work closely with the founders.
  • Basic psychology-based copywriting skills

Accountabilities

  • Brainstorm and pitch weekly ad ideas aligned with direct response principles.

  • Come up with static ad ideas on a weekly basis
  • Analyze performance metrics to derive actionable insights for future campaigns.

When hiring, we’ll work with you to define the KPIs you’ll be responsible for and set targets. This removes ambiguity around wondering if you’re doing a good job after you start.

Initial soft interview, then a technical interview + test project with the current head of marketing, and a final interview to ensure culture fit. We plan to hire within ~8 - 10 days of conducting these interviews. We pride ourselves on timely responses and updates for applicants.

For this specific role, we will walk you through the long-term vision and opportunities that have us excited about this business - and how you fit in. We will show you our current structure and where we are headed!
